# Redis: sync source stats

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To get sync source stats for a Redis database, send a SOURCE FACT REQUIRED request to the SOURCE FACT REQUIRED endpoint. The response contains SOURCE FACT REQUIRED fields such as SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the sync status and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the source details. Use this to monitor and validate replication health.

Search intents:
- redis sync source stats
- redis replication monitoring
- redis bdbs api

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/redis-sync-source-stats --json
